entries.text: Forty riflemen with an experimental grenade ability.
A forty-soldier formation inspired by the Howa Type 20. This prototype currently uses historical repeating-rifle equipment and animations. Automatic firing and grenade throwing remain experimental.
Repeating rifles.||Forty-soldier database target.||Battlefield behavior untested.
Temporarily throw explosive grenades at nearby enemies.
Throw Grenades ||Short-range explosive grenades. Two activations per battle.
